google_play.title: Wholecrate: Your Music, Once
google_play.short_description: Play the music on your own Navidrome or Subsonic server.
google_play.full_description:
Wholecrate is a web client for the music you already own.

Point it at a Navidrome or Subsonic server, log in, and your library is there: albums, artists, playlists, liked tracks. Audio streams straight from your server. Nothing is copied, re-hosted or uploaded anywhere else, and Wholecrate has no account of its own.

Built for a whole crate, not a highlight reel:
- One uniform shuffle. Every track in the queue plays once, then a fresh pass starts, without replaying the track that just ended.
- A queue you can see and edit. Add, remove, jump, clear.
- Playlists and likes saved to your server, so they survive a new browser or a new laptop.
- Search across whatever your server has scanned.
- No ads, no algorithm, no account to create.

What you need:
- A music library on a machine you control.
- Navidrome, or another server that speaks the Subsonic API.
- The server's address and a login for it.

What it does not do:
- It does not host or sell music. There is no catalogue and no importer from streaming services.
- It does not play offline. The audio lives on your server, so playback needs a connection to it.

Wholecrate is open source and has no paid tier. You pay only for your own server and storage, if anything.
